overall_notes: The paper focuses on chain-of-thought fine-tuning for natural language generation tasks. It evaluates generated rationales and answers using automatic metrics (accuracy and exact match) but does not use LLM judges or human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but included some items that were not relevant to the specific questions (e.g., ROSCOE metrics used for dataset analysis rather than output evaluation).
